ent.pending.publish: Published. The course list couldn't be updated just now, so learners will see this within 15 minutes. There is nothing to do again.
ent.pending.unpublish: Unpublished. The course list couldn't be updated just now, so learners may still see the course for up to 15 minutes. There is nothing to do again.
ent.pending.delete: Not deleted yet. The course is unpublished, but the course list couldn't be updated just now, so learners may still see it for up to 15 minutes. Delete it again after that.
ent.lang.xlsxFailed: The Excel file couldn't be made. Check your connection and try again, or download the CSV file instead.
ent.org.joinBody: The organization's admins and your teacher will see your lessons, scores, projects and certificates, including the ones from before you joined. You can leave from “Me”, unless the organization made your login.
ent.org.inOrg: You already belong to an organization. Leave it from “Me” first, then use the code.
